@@ -0,0 +1,153 @@
+// Package tracing constructs the trace provider and exporters used by the server.
+package tracing
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"maps"
+	"net"
+	"net/url"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"sync"
+
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/jaeger"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracegrpc"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracehttp"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/zipkin"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/resource"
+	tracesdk "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/trace"
+	semconv "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.4.0"
+)
+
+func newResource(ctx context.Context, fliptVersion string) (*resource.Resource, error) {
+	return resource.New(ctx,
+		resource.WithSchemaURL(semconv.SchemaURL),
+		resource.WithAttributes(semconv.ServiceNameKey.String("flipt")),
+		resource.WithFromEnv(),
+		resource.WithAttributes(semconv.ServiceVersionKey.String(fliptVersion)),
+	)
+}
+
+// NewProvider creates a Flipt tracer provider. Export processors can be
+// registered by the caller before the provider is used.
+func NewProvider(ctx context.Context, fliptVersion string) (*tracesdk.TracerProvider, error) {
+	res, err := newResource(ctx, fliptVersion)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+
+	return tracesdk.NewTracerProvider(
+		tracesdk.WithResource(res),
+		tracesdk.WithSampler(tracesdk.AlwaysSample()),
+	), nil
+}
+
+// GetExporter creates an exporter for cfg and returns a shutdown function for
+// that exporter. Each call owns its exporter, so configurations do not leak
+// across server instances or tests.
+func GetExporter(ctx context.Context, cfg *config.TracingConfig) (tracesdk.SpanExporter, func(context.Context) error, error) {
+	if cfg == nil {
+		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("tracing configuration is nil")
+	}
+
+	var (
+		exporter tracesdk.SpanExporter
+		err      error
+	)
+
+	switch cfg.Exporter {
+	case config.TracingJaeger:
+		exporter, err = jaeger.New(jaeger.WithAgentEndpoint(
+			jaeger.WithAgentHost(cfg.Jaeger.Host),
+			jaeger.WithAgentPort(strconv.Itoa(cfg.Jaeger.Port)),
+		))
+	case config.TracingZipkin:
+		exporter, err = zipkin.New(cfg.Zipkin.Endpoint)
+	case config.TracingOTLP:
+		client, parseErr := otlpClient(cfg.OTLP.Endpoint, cfg.OTLP.Headers)
+		if parseErr != nil {
+			return nil, nil, parseErr
+		}
+		exporter, err = otlptrace.New(ctx, client)
+	default:
+		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported tracing exporter: %d", cfg.Exporter)
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, nil, err
+	}
+
+	managed := &managedExporter{SpanExporter: exporter}
+	return managed, managed.Shutdown, nil
+}
+
+// The provider shuts down its span processors (and their exporters). The
+// server also calls the returned shutdown function, so both paths share the
+// same guard.
+type managedExporter struct {
+	tracesdk.SpanExporter
+	once sync.Once
+	err  error
+}
+
+func (e *managedExporter) Shutdown(ctx context.Context) error {
+	e.once.Do(func() { e.err = e.SpanExporter.Shutdown(ctx) })
+	return e.err
+}
+
+func otlpClient(endpoint string, headers map[string]string) (otlptrace.Client, error) {
+	headers = maps.Clone(headers)
+
+	if !strings.Contains(endpoint, "://") {
+		host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(endpoint)
+		if err != nil || host == "" || !validPort(port) {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint %q: expected host:port", endpoint)
+		}
+		return otlptracegrpc.NewClient(
+			otlptracegrpc.WithEndpoint(endpoint),
+			otlptracegrpc.WithHeaders(headers),
+			otlptracegrpc.WithInsecure(),
+		), nil
+	}
+
+	u, err := url.Parse(endpoint)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint %q: %w", endpoint, err)
+	}
+	if u.Hostname() == "" || u.User != nil || u.RawQuery != "" || u.Fragment != "" || (u.Port() != "" && !validPort(u.Port())) {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint %q: invalid URL", endpoint)
+	}
+
+	switch u.Scheme {
+	case "http", "https":
+		opts := []otlptracehttp.Option{
+			otlptracehttp.WithEndpoint(u.Host),
+			otlptracehttp.WithHeaders(headers),
+		}
+		if u.Path != "" {
+			opts = append(opts, otlptracehttp.WithURLPath(u.Path))
+		}
+		if u.Scheme == "http" {
+			opts = append(opts, otlptracehttp.WithInsecure())
+		}
+		return otlptracehttp.NewClient(opts...), nil
+	case "grpc":
+		if u.Path != "" && u.Path != "/" {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint %q: gRPC endpoint cannot have a path", endpoint)
+		}
+		return otlptracegrpc.NewClient(
+			otlptracegrpc.WithEndpoint(u.Host),
+			otlptracegrpc.WithHeaders(headers),
+			otlptracegrpc.WithInsecure(),
+		), nil
+	default:
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint %q: unsupported scheme %q", endpoint, u.Scheme)
+	}
+}
+
+func validPort(port string) bool {
+	n, err := strconv.Atoi(port)
+	return err == nil && n > 0 && n <= 65535
+}

+package tracing

+func TestNewResource(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "")
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES", "")
+
+	res, err := newResource(context.Background(), "v1.2.3")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "flipt", resourceValue(res.Attributes(), "service.name"))
+	assert.Equal(t, "v1.2.3", resourceValue(res.Attributes(), "service.version"))
+
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES", "service.name=from-attributes,service.version=from-environment,region=local")
+	res, err = newResource(context.Background(), "v1.2.3")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "from-attributes", resourceValue(res.Attributes(), "service.name"))
+	assert.Equal(t, "v1.2.3", resourceValue(res.Attributes(), "service.version"))
+	assert.Equal(t, "local", resourceValue(res.Attributes(), "region"))
+
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "from-service-name")
+	res, err = newResource(context.Background(), "v1.2.3")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "from-service-name", resourceValue(res.Attributes(), "service.name"))
+}
+
+func resourceValue(attrs []attribute.KeyValue, key attribute.Key) string {
+	for _, attr := range attrs {
+		if attr.Key == key {
+			return attr.Value.AsString()
+		}
+	}
+	return ""
+}

+	assert.True(t, span.SpanContext().IsSampled())
+	span.End()

+	provider := tracesdk.NewTracerProvider(tracesdk.WithSyncer(exporter))
+	defer func() { assert.NoError(t, provider.Shutdown(context.Background())) }()
+	_, span := provider.Tracer("test").Start(context.Background(), "exported")
+	span.End()
+
+	select {
+	case request := <-requests:
+		assert.Equal(t, "/custom/traces", request.URL.Path)
+		assert.Equal(t, "configured", request.Header.Get("x-test-header"))
+	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
+		t.Fatal("OTLP HTTP collector did not receive a span")
+	}
+}
